pages.title: Fitting Unit
pages.text: The Fitting Unit processes base materials into standard parts like plates and fiber sheets.$(br2)Power: 20 $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 item per 2 seconds$(br)Clearance: 3x3
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
